name: Qt Quick 3D
listed_description: Qt 6 module that renders 3D scenes in QML with native rendering, replacing the Qt 5 Qt Canvas 3D module that was built on three.js and WebGL.
listed_license: GPL v3 or commercial (from the repository page, not the book)
claim_text: Qt Quick 3D works a lot better than Qt Canvas 3D; native rendering, no three.js dependency, better performance.
book_benchmark: No measurement. Qualitative statement only; no workload, compiler or CPU given.
found_in: book: Qt 6 C++ GUI Programming Cookbook (2024), ch. 5 OpenGL Implementation, section Qt Quick 3D in QML, How it works (PDF page unavailable in chunk)

name: QML animators on the scene graph render thread
listed_description: Qt Quick animator types run directly on the scene graph render thread instead of the UI thread, so animation runs slightly faster than regular QML animation types.
claim_text: Animators operate on the render thread, so performance will be slightly better than running on the UI thread.
guessed_baseline: regular QML Animation types running on the UI thread
found_in: book: Qt 6 C++ GUI Programming Cookbook (2024), ch. 3 States and Animations with Qt and QML, section Animating widget properties using animators, There's more
